construction: Locally generated R13/R14 controls attach ACAD EED to the named-object dictionary. Remapped controls use NOD 0x35, group dictionary 0x34, ACAD APPID 0x33, and a named GROUP with one 3D LINE member. Producer JSON readback checks source references; UTF-8 text uses a fixed-size, CRC-repaired patch to the previously observed codepage-45 profile. Generated drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The shared legacy dictionary observer checks NOD framing and handle roles. The captured root must have a unique ACAD_GROUP target whose complete source owner is the root; the MLINESTYLE output path reuses this observer.

R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial ASCII/Binary controls cover original and remapped handles, ASCII and representable UTF-8, EED/APPID/source-frame/root-graph mutations, destination preservation and corrected retry. R14 also tests edited MLINESTYLE refusal.

A source with aliased ACAD_GROUP membership remains unqualified and is refused; the corrected graph succeeds on the same adapter. Unrepresentable target text is refused before destination replacement.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback finds NOD EED café and 42, a MYGROUP-to-LINE edge with original 3D coordinates, and the MLINESTYLE dictionary in ASCII and Binary output for both source versions.
limits: R13 output is explicit partial; its unqualified MLINESTYLE may be edited and does not gain a source-completeness certificate. Strict R13 remains refused.
Only this bounded ACAD APPID, dictionary and output profile is covered; native dictionary duplicate/clone semantics, other EED schemas and general format support remain open.
